acceptance.given: A non-empty Consumer Manifest and its applicable route transitions are available for rollback verification.

oracle.expected: The rollback verification records Prior Behavior Baseline observations for 100% of non-empty Consumer Manifest entries.
forbidden: Any non-empty Consumer Manifest entry lacks a Prior Behavior Baseline observation after rollback.
A route transition is omitted from the rollback verification set.
oracle.observable: The S7 or S41 test report contains one successful Prior Behavior Baseline observation for every non-empty Consumer Manifest entry after rollback, with complete route-transition coverage.

acceptance.then: After rollback, every non-empty Consumer Manifest entry observes the Prior Behavior Baseline.
acceptance.when: Execute the rollback replay test and inspect its per-entry route-transition observations.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the rollback replay selector with at least one non-empty Consumer Manifest entry missing its Prior Behavior Baseline observation or route transition; the runtime marker must be non-success.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Verify rollback replay restores and observes the Prior Behavior Baseline for every non-empty Consumer Manifest entry and rejects incomplete route-transition coverage.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing replay and Consumer Manifest schemas; rollback verification is additive.

slice_hint.state_transition: Manifest entries transition through applicable route replay, rollback, and baseline observation.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: All non-empty Consumer Manifest entries have recorded Prior Behavior Baseline observations after rollback; otherwise the test fails.

acceptance.given: A Matrix evaluation is configured with six Matrix Cases.

oracle.expected: Execution records show six Matrix Cases, each executed exactly once with an input pairwise distinct from the other five.
forbidden: Two or more Matrix Cases use the same input.
A Matrix Case lacks an input execution.
The execution record reports fewer than six Matrix Cases.
oracle.observable: The S32 or S41 matrix execution report enumerates six case identities and six pairwise-distinct input identities.

acceptance.then: All six Matrix Cases have executed with pairwise-distinct inputs.
acceptance.when: Run the matrix execution selector and evaluate the emitted case-to-input execution records.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Provide a matrix execution set with a duplicated input or omitted case and verify the aggregate result is non-success.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce and report execution of all six Matrix Cases with pairwise-distinct inputs.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Retain existing matrix and replay record formats while adding distinct-input validation.

slice_hint.state_transition: Matrix cases move from configured to executed with an input identity recorded for each case.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Exactly six executed case records exist and their input identities are pairwise distinct; any missing or duplicate input fails the aggregate.

acceptance.given: An adversarial validator case is presented for success evaluation.

oracle.expected: The adversarial validator case receives a non-success result.
forbidden: Success is accepted for an adversarial validator case.
oracle.observable: The validator test result or emitted verdict records a non-success terminal category for the adversarial case.

acceptance.then: Success is rejected for the adversarial validator case.
acceptance.when: Evaluate the adversarial validator case through the replay/evaluation path and inspect its terminal verdict.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the adversarial validator selector and assert that a success verdict is treated as a contract failure.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reject success verdicts produced for adversarial validator inputs and preserve a non-success terminal category.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep existing validator verdict categories and replay interfaces compatible.

slice_hint.state_transition: Adversarial input transitions from evaluated to a recorded non-success verdict.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The adversarial validator case has a non-success terminal result; any success result fails the check.

acceptance.given: A reused-evidence case is presented for success evaluation.

oracle.expected: The reused-evidence case receives a non-success result.
forbidden: Success is accepted for a reused-evidence case.
oracle.observable: The replay/evaluation report identifies the reused-evidence case and records a non-success terminal verdict.

acceptance.then: Success is rejected for the reused-evidence case.
acceptance.when: Evaluate the reused-evidence case through the replay/evaluation path and inspect its terminal verdict.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the reused-evidence selector and assert that any success verdict is reported as a contract failure.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Detect reused evidence during evaluation and reject any success verdict based on it.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing replay evidence schema while enforcing freshness and reuse rejection.

slice_hint.state_transition: Reused evidence transitions from evaluated input to a recorded non-success verdict.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The reused-evidence case has a non-success terminal result; any success result fails the check.
